title: Healthcare Book Club!
subtitle: I'm going to start recommending books to read!
text:
I haven't read this yet. I'm going to. And then I'm going to write about it. And I'm going encourage you to read it, and subsequently encourage you to leave a comment. I'm also going to encourage anyone who would like to consider submitting books to the Healthcare book club to do so.

Today’s book is by our friends at Walmart. That's not being facetious, when I say “friends.” I have friends at Walmart Health. I'm a big fan of what they are up to. Hi friends! 👋

Walmart's Second Opinion

It's got a forward from the Validation Institute’s Hall of Fame inductee Tom Emerick! That is like having Axel Rose forward your book about being a difficult rockstar.

I can't wait to read it, and I look forward to hearing with my readers think. High cost of healthcare is a major problem for health care.

—Owen Scott Muir, M.D.
